product.name: Codist Ops
product.oneLiner: Internal DevOps control plane for managing Codist product deployments, server ops, env secrets, and observability across Billable and Codist2 Hetzner servers.

servers.name: Codist2
servers.role: Codist Ops stack, EngineIQ, Caddy TLS

flashcards.question: What architectural pattern is Codist Ops and why not microservices?
flashcards.answer: Modular monolith with Clean Architecture and MediatR CQRS. Single API deployable matches small internal user base and dense integrations (SSH, GitHub, DB, SignalR). Microservices would add network failure modes without scaling benefit.

flashcards.question: Draw the request path from browser to Docker on Billable.
flashcards.answer: Browser HTTPS → Caddy on Codist2 → codist-ops-api:5080 → SSH.NET → billable@65.109.7.45:22 → docker ps/stats/logs commands → JSON parsed back to API → Angular UI.

flashcards.question: What is the single biggest SPOF and blast radius?
flashcards.answer: SSH private keys mounted in API container plus Owner JWT. Compromise yields arbitrary Docker command execution on production servers. No bastion, no command allowlist beyond code paths.

flashcards.question: Why does dashboard show partial data when SSH fails but Servers page errors?
flashcards.answer: GetDashboardQueryHandler uses SafeGet* try/catch returning null/empty. ServersController calls SSH directly and throws ValidationAppException → 400. Intentional degradation for aggregate view vs explicit failure on ops pages.

flashcards.question: How are Billable and Codist2 connected to the Ops API?
flashcards.answer: API runs on Codist2 in Docker. Outbound SSH to both servers using per-server config (host, user, key path). Not agent-based — imperative SSH from API process.
followUps: What network does API join for Caddy?

flashcards.question: What is the startup sequence of the API?
flashcards.answer: Serilog bootstrap → CreateBuilder → Loki sink → AddApiServices → Build → DatabaseInitializer (migrate, seed roles, owner, apps) → middleware pipeline → MapControllers/Hub/Health → Run.

flashcards.question: How does deployment status get from GitHub to the database?
flashcards.answer: Trigger creates Deployment (Queued). DeploymentStatusSyncService every 30s loads pending (Queued/Building, <2h old). SyncDeploymentStatusCommand fetches workflow run via Octokit, maps status via DeploymentWorkflowMapper, updates row.

flashcards.question: How does GitHub deployment import avoid duplicates?
flashcards.answer: ExistsByWorkflowRunIdAsync checks AppId + WorkflowRunId before CreateAsync. Skips existing runs. Idempotent on workflow run ID not commit hash.

flashcards.question: What roles exist and what can Viewer do?
flashcards.answer: Owner, Admin, Viewer. Viewer: dashboard, apps list/detail read, deployments read, servers read. Cannot: env vars, observability, team, deploy trigger, restart containers.

flashcards.question: Explain the error HTTP status mapping.
flashcards.answer: UnauthorizedAppException 401, ValidationAppException 400, NotFoundAppException 404, SshOperationException 502, other 500 with generic message in Production. JSON body: error + correlationId.

flashcards.question: Where is the N+1 query risk on dashboard load?
flashcards.answer: GetDashboardQueryHandler loops apps calling GetLatestByAppIdAsync per app — 6 apps = 6 queries. Should batch with single query grouped by AppId or include in GetAllForDashboardAsync.

flashcards.question: How are env var secrets stored?
flashcards.answer: AES-256-GCM via EncryptionService. Key SHA256 from Encryption:Key config. Nonce+ciphertext+tag base64 in EnvVariables.EncryptedValue. Push to server decrypts and writes plaintext .env over SSH.

flashcards.question: How does SignalR log streaming authenticate?
flashcards.answer: JWT Bearer with access_token query param on /hubs/logs (WebSocket limitation). LogStreamHub [Authorize]. LogStreamManager opens SSH stream when client joins group.

flashcards.question: What ORM and database provider?
flashcards.answer: Entity Framework Core 8 with Npgsql provider to PostgreSQL 16.

flashcards.question: What happens when container name doesn't match app slug?
flashcards.answer: ResolveContainerStatus returns NotFound with message 'No matching container found on server.' Matching uses Contains on LinuxUser or Slug — heuristic not Docker labels.

flashcards.question: How is auth state managed in Angular?
flashcards.answer: JWT in localStorage key codist_ops_token. AuthService BehaviorSubject currentUser$. Client-side JWT decode for role/expiry. jwtInterceptor attaches Bearer header.

flashcards.question: Why was environment.prod.ts apiUrl fix critical?
flashcards.answer: Was https://ops.codist.co.za/api but ApiService also prefixes /api → double /api/api/ paths. Fixed to https://ops.codist.co.za base only.

flashcards.question: How are routes lazy loaded?
flashcards.answer: Angular 18 loadComponent on each route — no NgModules. authGuard on shell children; roleGuard with route.data.roles for observability, team, audit, settings.

flashcards.question: Why no NgRx?
flashcards.answer: Small internal app; server state refetched per navigation; local BehaviorSubject sufficient. Avoids boilerplate for low-complexity global state (auth, toasts only).

flashcards.question: What happens on session expiry mid-use?
flashcards.answer: errorInterceptor catches 401 on non-auth endpoints → AuthService.logout → toast Session expired → navigate /login.

flashcards.question: What indexes exist on Deployments and why?
flashcards.answer: IX_Deployments_AppId (FK lookups), IX_Deployments_Status (pending sync filter), IX_Deployments_StartedAt (recent/history ordering). Missing composite AppId+StartedAt for latest-by-app.

flashcards.question: What cascades on App delete?
flashcards.answer: Deployments and EnvVariables cascade delete. AuditLog UserId is Restrict — cannot delete user with audit entries easily.

flashcards.question: What's wrong with GetSuccessRateLast30DaysAsync at scale?
flashcards.answer: ToListAsync all completed deployments then Count in memory — O(n) RAM. Should use two CountAsync SQL aggregations.

flashcards.question: Trace deploy from git push to live.
flashcards.answer: Push main → build-api + build-ui parallel Docker push GHCR → deploy job SSH docker compose pull up -d → sleep 20 → curl localhost:5080/health.

flashcards.question: Is deploy zero-downtime?
flashcards.answer: No. docker compose up -d recreates containers — brief API unavailability. No blue/green or rolling update.

flashcards.question: What must be on server besides .env?
flashcards.answer: docker-compose.override.yml with keys volume ./keys:/keys:ro and engineiq_default network. SSH key files in keys/ chmod 600.

flashcards.question: What CI checks run before merge?
flashcards.answer: None configured — only deploy workflow on main. No PR test/build gate in repo.

flashcards.question: JWT structure and expiry?
flashcards.answer: HMAC-SHA256. Claims: userId, email, role, sub, jti. ExpiryHours default 8. No audience validation. MapInboundClaims false.

flashcards.question: OWASP: biggest XSS impact here?
flashcards.answer: JWT in localStorage — stolen via XSS gives full role until expiry. SignalR query token same risk.

flashcards.question: Who can push env vars to production servers?
flashcards.answer: Owner only — POST /api/apps/{id}/env/push [Authorize(Roles = Owner)].

flashcards.question: Why poll GitHub instead of webhooks?
flashcards.answer: No inbound webhook endpoint/firewall config on internal MVP. 30s staleness acceptable. Simpler than HMAC webhook verification and retry logic.

flashcards.question: Why anemic domain entities?
flashcards.answer: Speed — app is integration-heavy CRUD. Business rules in handlers (import, sync, dashboard matching). Acceptable for internal tool; would enrich if deployment state machine grows rules.

flashcards.question: What would you remove from codebase?
flashcards.answer: Dual invite tables, Hetzner stub, hardcoded Grafana URLs, ConsoleEmailSender in production path without real email.

flashcards.question: Describe a production incident you fixed.
flashcards.answer: SSH keys not mounted post-deploy — dashboard NotFound. Diagnosed via API logs ValidationAppException. Fixed keys volume, billable user, restarted API.

flashcards.question: Quality vs speed trade-off on this project?
flashcards.answer: Shipped without tests but Clean Architecture interfaces allow later unit tests. Documented ONBOARDING for team self-service.

flashcards.question: What external services does API call on dashboard load?
flashcards.answer: 2 SSH sessions (stats+containers) × 2 servers + N HTTP health checks + multiple DB queries. Potentially 10+ network round trips per refresh.

flashcards.question: What is MediatR used for?
flashcards.answer: CQRS dispatch — controllers send Commands/Queries to handlers. Decouples HTTP from business logic. Enables future pipeline behaviors for validation/logging.

flashcards.question: Angular version and standalone components?
flashcards.answer: Angular 18.2 standalone — bootstrapApplication, no NgModules, functional guards/interceptors.

flashcards.question: Backup strategy for PostgreSQL?
flashcards.answer: Docker volume postgres_data on host only — no automated backup in repo. Loss of volume loses deployments, env ciphertext, audit log.

flashcards.question: Where does monitoring run vs Ops app?
flashcards.answer: Monitoring (Loki/Prometheus/Grafana) intended on Billable. Codist Ops API/UI on Codist2. Codist2 Promtail ships logs to Billable Loki.

flashcards.question: Rate limiting strategy?
flashcards.answer: None — internal tool low traffic. Risk if exposed publicly or token leaked — brute force login unthrottled.

flashcards.question: Why AES-GCM for env vars not database TDE?
flashcards.answer: Application-level encryption allows key rotation independent of Postgres; ciphertext useless without Encryption:Key even with DB dump.

systemDesignTopics.currentImplementation: Single Codist org — no tenant isolation
systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: Would add TenantId FK + global query filter + tenant claim in JWT before any SaaS externalization
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: How would you isolate Customer A from seeing Customer B deployments?

systemDesignTopics.currentImplementation: Polling via page load and 30s dashboard refresh pattern
systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: SignalR hub already exists for logs — extend with cached metrics push every 15s from background service
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: How would you show live CPU without hammering SSH?

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: GitHub webhook + HMAC signature verification + idempotent handler replaces poll; needs public HTTPS endpoint
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: Design webhook ingestion for workflow_run completed events

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: IMemoryCache for SSH results keyed by server with 30s TTL — biggest latency win for dashboard
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: What would you cache and how invalidate on container restart?

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: Missing RED metrics on API itself; SSH failure rate should be a Prometheus counter with alert
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: How would you know SSH silently failed for 24 hours?

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: Production-grade would use Vault or cloud KMS; SSH keys should be short-lived via SSH certificate authority
Postgres streaming replica for read path; dual API behind Caddy load balance requires SignalR Redis backplane
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: Make Ops portal survive Codist2 host failure

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: EF SaveChanges interceptor captures all mutations with before/after JSON — queryable compliance trail
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: Prove who changed env var X at time T

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: Config-driven flags for Grafana embed, Hetzner integration, import batch size without redeploy
systemDesignTopics.interviewQuestion: Roll out observability tab to Owners only first

systemDesignTopics.seniorInsight: Same REST API; need refresh tokens, push notifications on deploy complete via webhook→FCM

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about a difficult technical decision with incomplete information
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Deploying Codist Ops to production on new Codist2 server while Billable already hosted apps and monitoring
behaviouralAnchors.task: Choose hosting without disrupting existing stacks
behaviouralAnchors.action: Deployed Ops to Codist2, connected to Caddy via external Docker network engineiq_default, kept Loki/Grafana on Billable
behaviouralAnchors.result: ops.codist.co.za live without migrating EngineIQ or customer apps
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Evaluated network topology and blast radius rather than defaulting to same server as monitoring

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about a production incident
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Dashboard showed NotFound for all apps and 0% CPU after successful deploy
behaviouralAnchors.action: API logs showed SSH key path missing; copied keys, fixed .env user/paths, added compose volume mount, restarted API
behaviouralAnchors.result: SSH operations succeeded within one restart; server health populated
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Correlated browser 400s with backend ValidationAppException rather than assuming apps were down

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about balancing quality and speed
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Internal MVP deadline for Codist Ops portal
behaviouralAnchors.action: Shipped Clean Architecture seams without test projects; wrote ONBOARDING.md for operational runbooks
behaviouralAnchors.result: Team uses production portal daily; test debt explicitly documented
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Named the debt and preserved testability boundaries instead of skipping structure entirely

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about the most complex feature you built
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Need live Docker logs in browser without kubectl/port-forward culture
behaviouralAnchors.task: Stream container logs to Angular UI
behaviouralAnchors.action: SignalR hub + SSH.NET follow mode + subscriber refcounting in LogStreamManager + JWT query param auth
behaviouralAnchors.result: Owners/Admins view live logs from Servers and App detail pages
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Integrated three protocols (HTTPS, WSS, SSH) with lifecycle management

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about improving system behavior under failure
behaviouralAnchors.situation: SSH timeouts blocked entire dashboard when one server unreachable
behaviouralAnchors.task: Keep dashboard usable with partial infrastructure data
behaviouralAnchors.action: Wrapped SSH calls in SafeGet* helpers returning null/empty on failure for aggregate query only
behaviouralAnchors.result: Dashboard loads with partial stats; detail pages still surface errors explicitly
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Differentiated aggregate degradation from operational error propagation intentionally

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about a bug from GitHub/import work
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Sync from GitHub returned 500 mid-import; War Room showed Never deployed
behaviouralAnchors.action: PostgreSQL logs showed varchar(500) overflow on CommitMessage; added truncation in import handler
behaviouralAnchors.result: Import completes all apps including War Room after redeploy
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Traced 500 to DB constraint not GitHub API failure

behaviouralAnchors.question: Tell me about disagreeing with an approach
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Production .env configured Billable SSH as root with placeholder key paths
behaviouralAnchors.task: Align config with actual server hardening
behaviouralAnchors.action: Insisted on billable user and documented /keys mount in .env.example and compose override
behaviouralAnchors.result: SSH authentication succeeds with least privilege on Billable
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Connected security convention on server with application configuration

dangerZones.risk: XSS steals 8h Owner token with full infrastructure access
dangerZones.whatSeniorSays: JWT in localStorage with 8h expiry and no refresh — XSS is full account compromise until expiry; ActiveUserMiddleware revokes deactivated users but not stolen tokens; would move to httpOnly cookie + CSRF for production hardening

dangerZones.risk: API RCE or Owner JWT forgery equals root/billable on production servers
dangerZones.whatJuniorSays: The API connects to servers via SSH
dangerZones.whatSeniorSays: The API mounts long-lived private keys read-only and opens new SSH sessions per request — blast radius is total Docker control; mitigation today is RBAC and audit log, not network isolation or command allowlisting

dangerZones.risk: Misdiagnose SSH misconfiguration as application outage
dangerZones.whatJuniorSays: The app status is NotFound so the app isn't running
dangerZones.whatSeniorSays: NotFound means container name heuristic failed or SSH failed silently on dashboard — check API logs for ValidationAppException and verify keys before restarting customer containers

dangerZones.risk: Green container + red health or vice versa
dangerZones.whatJuniorSays: Health check failed so deployment failed
dangerZones.whatSeniorSays: Container matching and HTTP health are independent signals — The Record can show NotFound or health 404 if /health path wrong while container runs; diagnose each path separately

dangerZones.risk: Regression ships to production on every main push
dangerZones.whatSeniorSays: Deploy workflow is build-push-SSH with health check only — no unit/integration gate; varchar truncation and double /api URL class of bugs reach prod; would add dotnet test and ng test before merge as minimum bar
